mapper.insert: INSERT INTO terminal_sessions (session_id, open_message_id, server_id, user_id, status, last_activity_at) VALUES (#{session.sessionId}, #{session.openMessageId}, #{session.serverId}, #{session.userId}, #{session.status}, #{session.lastActivityAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM terminal_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND open_message_id = #{openMessageId}
SELECT FROM terminal_sessions WHERE server_id = #{serverId} AND status IN ('opening', 'open') ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM terminal_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('opening', 'open') ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE terminal_sessions SET status = 'open', shell_identifier = #{shellIdentifier}, opened_at = #{openedAt}, last_activity_at = #{openedAt} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'opening'
